records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total Net sales for the three months ended September 30, 2022 increased $916 million, or 17.3%, to $6,216 million, compared to the three months ended September 30, 2021.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net sales growth was driven by all operating segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This decrease was primarily due to the absence of share repurchases in 2022 and increased volume through our inventory financing arrangements, partially offset by repayments on our senior unsecured term loan facility and net repayments on our revolving loan facility.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase in Gross profit margin was primarily driven by more favorable product mix and rate and higher mix of netted down revenue, as well as increased Net sales and margins on services as a result of the recent business acquisitions.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating income was $466 million for the three months ended September 30, 2022, an increase of $80 million, or 20.7%, compared to $386 million for the three months ended September 30, 2021.
